release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.0.0

• **Three New Signature Themes**: Neon Pulse, Royal Gold, and Pure Minimal, plus translucent Liquid Glass playlists, Cover Studio customizer, Adaptive Playlist Themes, and Battery Saver Mode.
• **HoloDeck 3D, Cinematic Focus & Pixel Shift**: Interactive gyroscope/tilt HoloDeck artwork, distraction-free Cinematic Focus stage, tile-based Pixel Shift transitions, and Live Animated Cover Arts.
• **Audio Quality, Music Videos & Lyrics**: Refined High/Ultra/Lossless tiers, restored Music Videos playback on Windows & Android with a dedicated Home shelf, BT/TWS double-tap pause/resume fix, Gentle Sleep Timer fade, and word-synced lyrics precision.
• **Discovery, Mobile & Sharing**: Onboarding permissions & walkthrough, Android Home Widget, Android Discord Rich Presence, HumSearch melody matching, Genre Explorer, Guess The Track, Story Studio (9:16 posters), Lyric Quote Cards, and QR Connect.
• **Personal Hub & Pro Audio**: Music Diary, Monthly Music Story, Album Relationship Scores, Forgotten Gems, Artist Timeline, Playlist Splitter, Achievements, and Argon Audio Lab.
